use_case_summary: Programmatic adserver: bidder + personalization/reranking at request-time. Must make model calls in the 10s-100s ms window for decisions. Throughput peaks ~2k RPS per region. Strong cost pressure; target unit cost to beat current self-hosted LLM infra. Interested in batching, prefix/KV caching, and aggressive quantization to reduce GPU footprint.
notes:
- Wants end-to-end POC that demonstrates 99th percentile tail latency and token-level cost impact.
- Latency SLO: p99 < 50ms for small reranking calls (~30-150 tokens).
- Throughput target: sustained 1500-2500 RPS for Europe + NA, burst to 4k.
- Quality requirement: acceptable delta <= 3% top-1 rerank accuracy vs baseline float32 model.
- Strong interest in: continuous batching, prefix/KV cache effectiveness, INT8 and 4-bit quantization profiles, and hybrid routing (fast small model for majority + heavyweight fallbacks).
- "If you can shave tails and cut cost by 40% we buy Dedicated" — quote from CTO (Samir Dutta).
- Current stack: bidding service in Go, Redis-based state + per-request context cache, deployment in GCP with VPC-native services.
- Network/security ask: VPC peering or private link; no public egress for ad payloads. Data residency: US-EAST for initial rollouts.
- Integration asks: KMS for model keys, audit logs retained 90d (initial request 30d ok), SAML SSO for Redwood console.
- SE notes: want perf harness that runs 10M synthetic requests across sequence length distribution, collect batching stats, cache hit rates, and per-token GPU cost. See drive:/RapidCurrent/Perf/latency_benchmarks_QC.xlsx for initial numbers.
- Action items: Redwood to deliver quantized model perf matrix (INT8/4-bit) + canary plan for A/B accuracy checks. Price sensitivity: negotiating committed monthly pricing for Dedicated pool.
- Risk: in-house infra team worried about degraded reranking quality after quantization; ask for rollback/fallback routing guidance.
